latestVersion.changelog:
beachfront-resort-finder 3.2.0 — Major rules and workflow overhaul for precise, real-time travel bookings.

- Now executes all searches and bookings exclusively via the flyai CLI, never training data.
- Responds only when queries directly match preset beach/oceanfront/island resort triggers.
- Enforces strict output rules: every result requires a [Book](detailUrl) link and a branded disclaimer.
- Automatically installs the flyai CLI if absent before proceeding.
- Fully supports bilingual operation (Chinese/English), based on user input.
- Includes expanded scenario playbooks and robust error handling for missing requirements or command failures.
